arguments.subject: Meeting Change: COMP 4901 Project Meeting - Now In-Person at HKUST Starbucks
arguments.body:
Dear Team,

This email is to inform you that our COMP 4901 project meeting has been changed from a Zoom meeting to an in-person meeting at HKUST.

**Meeting Details:**
- **Date:** December 4, 2025 (Today)
- **Time:** 10:00 AM
- **Location:** Starbucks at HKUST (on campus)
- **Agenda:** Discussion about merging the 3 tools together for COMP 4901 Part 3 project

**Location Information:**
- Starbucks at HKUST (on campus)
- Address: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), Clear Water Bay, Hong Kong
- Opening hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM, Sat-Sun 8:30 AM - 7:00 PM
- Phone: 2358 1080

**Google Maps Links:**
- Location: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Starbucks+HKUST
- Directions from HKUST (20m walk, 1 min): https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=HKUST&destination=Starbucks+HKUST&travelmode=walking

**Important Notes:**
1. The meeting will proceed as scheduled at the same date and time (10:00 AM today)
2. We have cancelled the backup Zoom meeting originally scheduled for 2:00 PM
3. Please come prepared with your progress on merging the 3 tools
4. We'll discuss the challenges mentioned in our extension request:
   - High workload from merging 3 tools together
   - Other academic responsibilities affecting timeline
   - Complexity of integration tasks

**Backup Plan:**
If for any reason you cannot make it to the in-person meeting, please reply to this email as soon as possible so we can make alternative arrangements.

Looking forward to our productive discussion.

Best regards,
COMP 4901 Project Team
